symptoms.basis: Description: 'Tenant called in saying it was cold in their suite.' 0:30: 'I've already verified that I have air flow'.

sampling_truth_basis: The first-listed accepted cause of each complaint in the base case: electric element, fuse and connections at T212; a melting wire at T117 (whose own element worked). Used only to draw the answers of checks the video does not show.

technician.scope: From the first BAS look to the statement of each accepted cause. Excluded, decided before any run: whatever happened before 0:00 (arrival, the earlier BAS look in the description, the airflow check), walking to the units (1:30-1:45) and the repairs (4:30-5:15 and 5:45-6:15).

steps.what: T212 in the BAS: heat stage on, damper 58%, discharge 62.8 F
T117 in the BAS (no graphic, point list): heat stage on, discharge 62 F
At T212: contactors, 24 V, three-phase supply, limit switch, amp draw, load-side voltage, fuse continuity (about seven measurements inside one catalogue check)
At T117: fuses and wiring; a burning wire found

technician.diagnosis_basis: The accepted causes are the technician's own findings, so he cannot lose on accuracy by construction.
technician.verified: Yes for T212: current restored after the fuse and wires were fixed (5:00-5:15); T117 pulling about 10 A, normal for its element (6:00).
